TanStack Query prefetch on intent (JavaS.description:
Warm the cache on hover and focus so the next navigation renders immediately. Requires useQueryClient from @tanstack/react-query and a queryOptions factory.

在悬停与聚焦时预热缓存，使下一次导航立即渲染；需要 @tanstack/react-query 的 useQueryClient，以及一个 queryOptions 工厂函数。
